notes.title: Devlog #5 - (Part-II ) - Release
notes.content:
Currently only available for Windows platform.


[h1]Part-II Features & Notes[/h1]
[list][*]In Part-II, Each Case  needs the final answer to be unlocked. 10 Checkpoints serve as 10 Evidence files. Few of them might be useless or misdirection. The player has to process all evidence files to find the final solution. Some evidence files may redirect to external puzzles too.[/*][*]A Launcher screen, that will help in making/selecting User profile for multiple game-saves.[/*][*]Puzzles in the form of 3D objects, live CCTV footage, Videos logs, Location tracking and more![/*][*]Few puzzles may need real email interaction. The interaction can be either automated or with a real human, depending on the specific puzzle and progress.[/*][*]Improvement in the Story-line.[/*][*]Hyblabs.com, hybrionalabs.com and hybridlabs.com are fake domain names. If a different domain name occurs in the game then it's the real one. For example, a real email id. [/*][*]In case you want to use disposable email ids then make sure you also take  a copy of the mail for future reference.[/*][*]Some commands in the Console app need internet access.[/*][*]Games like this are difficult to test so there could be many uncaught bugs. Feel free to report it via email or Steam community.[/*][*]Game save file directory is changed.[/*][*]Increased existing photos quality.[/*][*]Completely changed the way answers were validated. Now using tags.  [/*][/list]

notes.title: Devlog #0 - Updates till Now - (Part-II - 60%) [14th June 2017)
notes.content:
[url=https://hybriona.itch.io/mystery-puzzle-hunt/devlog/2870/devlog-0-updates-till-now-part-ii-60] Original Post[/url]

[i]Refer original post to view screenshots/videos.[/i]



[h1] Feature Additions[/h1]

- Game Save Profile (90%): 5 Save Game profiles to start a new game without deleting previous save files manually. But the game needs to be restarted to switch Save-profile.

- Game Story as Vlogs (20%): Text Cutscenes will be replaced by Video Cutscenes. Completed till Case 2.

- Improvements in Check Answer Logic (100%): The Answer checking logic has been improved to identify tags and now no longer depends on the order of the words.

- Steam Cloud Support (100%): Sync Save files across all your devices (only applicable if downloaded from Steam).

[h1] Gameplay Changes for Part-II (After 3 Iterations)[/h1]

- Each Case now needs the final answer to be unlocked. 10 Checkpoints serve as 10 Evidence files. Few of them might be useless or misdirection. The player has to process all evidence files to find the final solution. Some evidence files may redirect to external puzzles too. 

- Puzzle Design (60%): 3 Cases out of 5 are finalized.

- Object and mechanical puzzles. 

- (100%) Few puzzles may need real email interaction. The interaction can be either automated or with a real human, depending on the specific puzzle and progress.

[h1] Fixes [/h1]

- Video quality improvement.

- Video puzzle playback improvement. Now It plays full screen for better visibility.

notes.title: Update 1500 (All platforms)
notes.content:
[h1]- Part I is completely re-written by a Good Writer. [/h1]
All the cases and checkpoints of Part I is completely re-written. So the whole writing is improved and not just the grammar.

[h1]- Added handy Notes tool [/h1]
The old notes app was not useful (mistake in my game design.. lol) So, a new Notes tool is added which can be invoked in any screen using F2 or F7. And this tool can also be dragged. (Just like sticky notes) 
The old notes will be still functional. The old notes and the new notes app will share the same data.

[h1] - Added Borderless window support ** [/h1]
** Borderless Window support is added for Windows and Linux (Experimental)


[h1] - The First Manual [/h1]
Also, for general instructions, controls and tips visit steam discussions.


Thanks for all feedback and suggestions. Keep supporting this game :)

I know you people are waiting for Part II. :(  It will be unlocked when the Proofreading (actually it's rewriting) gets completed. Though it is taking more time than expected but the output is really satisfying. As it is all about giving a better experience in terms of good writing and not just good grammar!
